assumption: Shared pagefile handles and their duplicated views retain the same Arc<SharedObject> identity; file-backed section aliases are outside this admitted constructor profile.
basis: current unnamed pagefile constructor stores a single Arc shared by duplicated handles; native controls use one section for both endpoints
stress-test: multiple overlapping views, section handle close, partial unmap and allocation reuse
falsification-probe: separate admitted Arc identities reference the same pagefile object or a duplicate view incurs an extra physical backing charge

assumption: Port view cleanup follows the final local handle, even if other object references remain; explicit unmap must prevent stale cleanup of a replacement.
basis: 30 independently inspected private LPC native cases;126closes,60released views and6private replacements preserved/freed
dependent-result: typed endpoint last-handle hooks and generation tokens
stress-test: duplicate-close-source, protected close, process drain, explicit unmap/private or mapped reuse
falsification-probe: one endpoint close retires the peer view, internal refs defer local cleanup, or stale cleanup touches replacement

assumption: Selected CSR reply metadata must match the selected section and session; native CSR pointers are opaque server addresses and never dereferenced in guest VM construction.
basis: independent native first-call and own-PEB metadata relationships at statics offset0x750; nonzero sessions currently unknown
stress-test: mismatched capture/session/section,32bit address fit and snapshot lifetime
falsification-probe: successful connection combines metadata from different section/session identities or forwards guest pointers to host
